page.layout: Two columns of a Hebrew-Latin word list, left and right, on one printed page. Running head at top left and top right. Page number top right. Signature at bottom left. Catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: הַבְּהֵבִים, בִּי donaria, בִּי mea, &c. No. pl. m. Rad. יָהַב dedit.
הַבּוֹ dirigendo, Infi. Niph. Rad. בָּוַז [?].
הַבּוּק exhauriendo, Infin. Niph. Rad. בָּקַק.
לְהַבְּזוֹת ad spermendum, Infin. Hiph. Rad. בָּזָה.
הַבַּט, vel הַבִּיט intuere, vel intueri, Imper. vel Infin. Hiph. הִבַּטְתֶּם vi-distis, præt. Hiph. 2. pl. m. Rad. נָבַט.
הַבִּיא venire fecit, הֵבִיאוֹ ipsum, item, הֵבִא venire fecit, הֵבִיאֲתָנוּ venire fecisti nos, præt. Hiph. 3. f. & 2. s.m.aff. Rad. בּוֹא.
הַבִּיאָם intuetur, הַבִּיט intuentur, præt. Hiph 3. f. & pl. m. הַבִּישָׁה intuere, Imper. Hiph. f.m. parag. Rad. נָבַט.
3. f. m. הָבִין intelligere, vel facintelligere, Infin. vel Imper. Hiph. sing. masc. Rad. בִּין.
הַבִּישׁ, vel הִבִּישׁ, sive הוֹבִישׁ pudefecit, 3. f. masc. הַבִּישָׁה, & הוֹבִּישָׁה, vel הִבַּשְׁתָּ pudefecisti, 2. sing. m. præt. Hiph. Rad. בּוּשׁ.
הַכְּנִיָּה ædificata, Part. Pahul Kal, sfæm. Rad. בָּנָה.
לְהִכָּנוֹת ut ædificetur, Inf. Niph. Rad. בָּנָה.
הַכָּנִים filii, No. pl. m. à sing. בֵּן, in Rad. בָּנָה.
הַכָּנִים ebena ligna, No. pl. m. Rad. הָבֵן.
הַבַּנִּים, vel הַפּוֹנִים ædificantes, pl. m. Ben. Kal, Rad. בָּנָה.
לְהַבָּקֵעַ ad disrumpendum, Infin. Niph. Rad בָּקַע.
הַבְּקִיעָה perrupta est, præt. Hoph. 3. sing. fæm. Rad. בָּקַע.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are uncertain in several entries and are written as far as legible. Marked [?] where the reading of a root or vowel is doubtful. The "3. f. m." at the head of the right column is faint. The printed "Hiph" in the entry for ad spermendum is kept as printed.
